第五章顾家被三管齐下

魏淑萍当然不会按死一个姑娘，再说对于顾城的处理还得有人家舅舅参与，见好就收才是硬道理。

“行吧，以后多劝劝孩子，找男人一定要擦亮眼睛，别像我一家眼瞎，找了个畜生。”

“是是是，我一定好好劝。”

而顾城还是直愣愣的站着，可能是有底气，也可能是依然事不关己高高挂起。

“妈，我想见见闫嫣。”

“行啊，想见就明天去民政局见。”

“妈，什么意思，我真没打闫嫣。”

“哼，继续装，你没打难道真没看见你妈打？装太过就没意思了，孩子已经被你妈打掉，闫嫣绝不会再进你家门受罪，明天实相点就乖乖去离婚，不然······”

魏淑萍冷冷一笑，不管是原主还是她亲闺女，所受的罪是实打实的，一家三口，甚至多年后整个闫家都家破人亡，这笔帐是要好好的慢慢的算。

顾城站在原地，双拳紧握，目送着三人离开。

“顾城，对不起我没帮到你。”

“苗倩，给我滚回家去，省得在厂里丢人现眼。”

叫苗倩的姑娘已经算大胆了，但内心深处更怕家人的责骂，赶紧一溜烟捂着脸跑了。

“顾城最近先回家把事给处理了，等我们向公安了解情况后再对你做出处理。”

顾城掉头就走，他要见见闫嫣。

顾城没先回家是对的，此刻的顾家早就没了睡觉的窝。

闫家一行人扛着家里能带的一切“武器”站在红旗大队地头，闫解放媳妇王静只扫过几眼就精准的找到顾老太婆，附近还有她大儿媳和小闺女，很好，她一个人能战俩。

“媳妇，地里的仨人交给你们几个，狠狠揍，把嫣嫣受过的伤全给还回来。

剩下的小子们去把顾家给我砸了，务必砸到今晚姓顾的没地方住。

我去找红旗大队大队长谈谈，就在大队部等你们。”

闫解放毕竟是大队长，不能亲自动手，但他能拦住红旗大队的所有领导班子，没人管顾家人就能多挨几顿。

“好，各忙各的。”

Chapter 5 The Gu family was attacked by a three-pronged approach

Of course, Wei Shuping would not kill a girl. Besides, someone's uncle must be involved in dealing with Gu Cheng.

"Okay, in the future, please advise your children to keep their eyes open when looking for a man. Don't be like my family who were blind and found a beast."

"Yes, yes, I will definitely advise you."

But Gu Cheng still stood there blankly, maybe because he was confident, or maybe because he still didn't care about the matter.

"Mom, I want to meet Yan Yan."

"Okay, if you want to meet, you can go to the Civil Affairs Bureau tomorrow to meet."

"Mom, what do you mean, I really didn't hit Yan Yan."

"Hmph, keep pretending. Didn't you really see your mother beat you when you didn't fight? It's pointless to pretend too much. The child has been aborted by your mother. Yan Yan will never come into your house again and suffer. Tomorrow, be honest and get divorced, otherwise..."

Wei Shuping smiled coldly. Whether it was the original owner or her own daughter, the crime they suffered was real. A family of three, and even the entire Yan family would be destroyed many years later. This debt must be settled carefully and slowly.

Gu Cheng stood there, clenching his fists, watching the three people leave.

"Gu Cheng, I'm sorry I couldn't help you."

"Miao Qian, go home, so as not to embarrass yourself in the factory."

The girl named Miao Qian was already considered bold, but deep down she was more afraid of being scolded by her family, so she quickly ran away covering her face.

"Gu Cheng went home recently to deal with the matter. We will deal with you after we learn about the situation from the police."

Gu Cheng turned around and left. He wanted to see Yan Yan.

Gu Cheng was right not to go home first. At this moment, the Gu family had long lost a place to sleep.

The Yan family stood at the edge of the Red Flag Brigade carrying all the "weapons" they could bring. Yan Jiefang's daughter-in-law Wang Jing only took a few glances to accurately find the old woman Gu. There were also her eldest daughter-in-law and her younger daughter nearby. It was good, she could fight them both on her own.

"Daughter-in-law, I will leave the three people in the field to you, beat them severely, and restore all the injuries Yanyan suffered.

The rest of the boys are going to destroy the Gu family. They must destroy it until there is no place for Gu to live tonight.

I'll go talk to the captain of the Red Flag Brigade and I'll wait for you at the brigade headquarters."

After all, Yan Jiefang is the captain of the brigade and cannot do it himself, but he can stop all the leaders of the Red Flag brigade, so that if no one cares about his family, he can get a few more beatings.

"Okay, everyone is busy with their own affairs."
